svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: How a change is delivered in Project Aether. The operator pushes to main on GitHub, and Renovate opens a pull request once a release is three days old. GitHub Actions runs pre-commit, kubeconform, Helm values lint, promtool and a SOPS check. GitHub sends a signed webhook through Cloudflare and the edge VM's outbound tunnel to ArgoCD on the cluster, which refreshes only the apps whose paths changed. The repo server fetches Git, and KSOPS decrypts secrets inside it with the local age key. Secrets are encrypted for two keys, a local age key and a Cloud KMS key. Ansible for hosts and Terraform for machines are applied by hand. Cluster updates wait for the operator to merge. Cloud host app updates merge themselves when CI is green; a Kestra flow on the cloud host then asks on Telegram, and on Deploy now it dumps the database, pulls the new image, recreates the container and restores the old version if the new one is not healthy. Another Kestra flow sends a Telegram message for each new Renovate pull request. The root app applies the cluster in sync waves and waits for each to be healthy: namespaces, then operators, then config, controllers, network policies and ingress, databases, and last the apps.
svg.text: A push is checked, then ArgoCD applies only what changed. Secrets stay encrypted in Git. App updates ask on Telegram.
